summary: Cypherpunk Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of mining equipment and hosting agreements from Moria Mining, LLC and Winklevoss Treasury Investments (WTI) via a wholly owned subsidiary. The $33,333,333 purchase price is payable through a pre-funded warrant to acquire 43,290,042 shares of common stock at $0.001 per share. The warrant includes a 19.99% beneficial ownership limitation and is exercisable immediately via cash or cashless exercise. The transaction closed on August 17, 2026. Watch for shareholder dilution and any regulatory or Nasdaq listing implications from the issuance.
